request.query: The determinant of a matrix times the transpose of another equals the product of their determinants over a commutative ring

items.name: Matrix.det_mul_comm
items.type:
∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M N : Matrix m m R),
  (M * N).det = (N * M).det

items.name: Matrix.det_transpose
items.type:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R),
  M.transpose.det = M.det

items.name: Matrix.det_mul
items.type:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (M N : Matrix n n R),
  (M * N).det = M.det * N.det

items.name: Matrix.detMonoidHom
items.type:
{n : Type u_2} →
  [inst : DecidableEq n] → [inst_1 : Fintype n] → {R : Type v} → [inst_2 : CommRing R] → Matrix n n R →* R

items.name: LinearMap.det_prodMap
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {M' : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : AddCommGroup M'] [inst_4 : Module R M'] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Free R M'] [Module.Finite R M]
  [Module.Finite R M'] (f : Module.End R M) (f' : Module.End R M'),
  LinearMap.det (LinearMap.prodMap f f') = LinearMap.det f * LinearMap.det f'
